05:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: NFL Matchup
Sal Paolantonio, Matt Bowen and Greg Cosell bring viewers inside the film room for the X's and O's analysis of the weekend's NFL matchups.

05:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The Gators (5-4) take on the No. 11 Wildcats (7-2) at Kroger Field for an SEC game. Kentucky dropped their previous game 34-6 against Tennessee and look to Kenny Minchey, while Florida seek to snap a two-game skid and fell 23-7 to Oklahoma.
